summary: Focused frontend retest of landing iteration97 fixes on public preview completed. Desktop/mobile hero layout, sticky/help gating, menu accessibility, responsive overflow, and regression smoke flows now pass. No sustained XP load warning reproduced on stable landing loads.

integration_issues.issue: Hard WebGL-disable simulation via runtime getContext override did not reliably force constructor failure in this browser harness; fallback behavior was validated via forced webglcontextlost event instead.

action_items: No landing code changes required from this retest based on current acceptance checks.
Optional: add a deterministic QA toggle to disable WebGL at app level for easier fallback regression automation.
critical_code_review_comments: LandingPage hero gating now uses ResizeObserver + rAF-throttled scroll/resize and correctly prevents early sticky/help mounts at mobile initial load.
Mobile menu accessibility warning (missing Description/aria-describedby) is resolved with explicit SheetDescription and close control.
No style leakage detected to non-landing routes during this smoke pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated requested breakpoints and flows on https://fintech-mvp-38.preview.emergentagent.com. Hero-scene gap measured +8px desktop (1920x800). Mobile 390x844 fresh load shows no sticky/help mounts; both appear after hero pass and hide at top; sticky dismiss persists. Hero copy renders 'doing. Build'. Sheet close via explicit button/Escape/anchor works. Responsive checks at 320/768/1024/1440 showed no horizontal overflow and no hero-scene overlap. XP warning '[xp] loadLevels failed' did not recur on stable landing runs.
rca of the issue: Previously reported landing overlap and mobile interference defects are resolved by moving hero scene/toolbar into normal flow, tightening passed-hero detection with bounding-box based gating, and rendering help/sticky only post-hero. Remaining note is automation-level WebGL hard-disable simulation variability, not a sustained functional landing defect.
